Attachment stubs: redwood_activation_playbook_v2.pdf (63 pages, activation playbook), acme_activation_checklist.xlsx (checklist + roles)

Planned actions (owners):
- Pre-cutover probes against staging (michael_grant) — 2027-05-10 22:00-23:00 UTC. We'll produce semantic probe logs and a short report.
- FW rule confirmation (soojin_lee) — firewall rule IDs + CIDR list.
- Rollforward/rollback lead & SLO watch (grace_oconnor) — I will own the rollback trigger thresholds and handoff.
- Bridge & escalation (marissa_cole) — I'll coordinate exec escalations if anything blocks cutover.

Probe details (for your LB):
- /healthz (GET) -> 200 {"status":"ok","kv_warm":true,"uptime_s":...} ; p95 backend < 120ms expected once KV warmed.
- /metrics/summary (GET) -> plain text with token-per-second counters; we'll provide the expected ranges in the playbook.
- KV warm indicator: key_count >= 85% of working set for the first 10 minutes of live traffic. If key_count < 60% after 15m we execute rollback.

Rollback plan (short):
- Immediate traffic-shift by routing policy: 80% -> previous hosted fallback (automated), 20% -> new cluster for triage. Full rollback if error rate > 5% sustained for 3m or p95>500ms for 5m.

I'll be on the bridge for the Monday dry-run and the Tuesday window. Michael will post the logs to the shared Drive after the dry-run.

Subject: Pre-cutover probe run results (staging)

Ran the scheduled probe sweep against staging at 2027-05-10 22:05 UTC. Summary below, uploading raw logs as precutover_probe_results.log.

- /healthz: 120 checks, 120 successes, median 18ms, p95 48ms. JSON sample: {"status":"ok","kv_warm":true,"uptime_s":56000}.
- /metrics/summary: token/sec baseline 800-950; no spikes.
- KV warm check: measured key_count 89% of working set after 8 minutes. Cache hit rate: 92%.
- Small transient 502 around 22:14 (0.8% of requests) — traced to an NTP drift on a staging node; fixed, not seen in subsequent sweeps.

Recommended go/no-go: GO for Tue window provided we keep watch on KV warming in the first 12m and monitor p95. I pushed the probe logs to Drive and attached the short CSV summary.

Attachment: precutover_probe_results.log (8MB), probe_summary_20270510.csv
